title: EvaLLM: Interactive Evaluation of Large Language Model Prompts on User-Defined Criteria
reasoning: The paper discusses the evaluation of LLM-generated explanations, specifically noting that the 'evaluations struggled to assess creativity and could be too superficial in their interpretations. For example, news article headlines were considered to adequately address ethical dilemmas by simply including the phrase “ethical concerns”'. This indicates that the paper's evaluation framework includes a component of assessing how LLMs handle ethical considerations.
